1. test_user and admin_user fixtures return tuples, not objects
   Fix: Extract user from tuple: user_id = test_user[0].id if isinstance\(test_user, tuple\) else test_user.id

   - published → published_at \(NewsArticle\)
   - locked → is_locked \(ForumThread\)
   - archived → is_archived \(ForumCategory\)

EOF)
